AfterAddedToRoom.rationale: The sim has no add-to-room phase - creature creation *is* construction - so AfterAddedToRoom's effect is applied from __init__ (infested_prism.py:37-39). GenerateMoveStateMachine.rationale: Four-node fixed cycle, no branch state. C# (InfestedPrism.cs:62-78): JAB -> RADIATE -> WHIRLWIND -> PULSATE -> JAB, registered in that order, initialState = JAB. The sim wires the identical ring, the identical registration order and the same initial state. The multi-intent moves map onto the sim's Intent(..., also=(...)) tuple: RADIATE carries SingleAttackIntent + DefendIntent -> also=(DEFEND,), PULSATE carries SingleAttackIntent + BuffIntent + DefendIntent -> also=(BUFF, DEFEND) in the same order (seam boundary item 2 owns the intent vocabulary itself).

guards.what: the four moves' damage, block and power numerics
guards.rationale: JabDamage (DeadlyEnemies, 17, 15) -> 15; RadiateDamage (DeadlyEnemies, 13, 11) -> 11 and RadiateBlock (DeadlyEnemies, 13, 11) -> 11; WhirlwindDamage (DeadlyEnemies, 6, 5) -> 5 with WhirlwindRepeat = 3 (a literal, :52); PulsateDamage (DeadlyEnemies, 10, 8) -> 8 and PulsateBlock (ToughEnemies, 22, 20) -> 20; VitalSparkAmount -> 2 (InfestedPrism.cs:38-52). Sim constants at infested_prism.py:15-22 are 15/11/11/5/3/8/20/2. Note the two block values key off DIFFERENT ascension levels (Radiate on DeadlyEnemies, Pulsate on ToughEnemies); both non-ascension arms are taken.

guards.what: in-move ordering: damage before block, block before the power
guards.rationale: RadiateMove damages then GainBlock (InfestedPrism.cs:90-94); PulsateMove damages, GainBlocks, then applies VitalSpark (:109-114). The sim keeps both orders (infested_prism.py:67-70, 75-80). This matters because the block is gained AFTER the attack resolves, so it cannot absorb a retaliation triggered by the attack.

Both GainBlock calls pass ValueProp.Move (InfestedPrism.cs:94, 113), i.e. POWERED block that Dexterity/Frail modifiers see. BlockCmd.apply (cmds.py:131-151) defaults props to ValueProp.MOVE, which is the same arm - the sim's unpowered path is only taken when a caller passes ValueProp.UNPOWERED explicitly. Rule 7: leans on sts2_rl/cmds.py, unhashed.
